text: Found why. 1) A second account was woken because the wake job gave the first account only 60 s to answer, and a sleeping account needs longer than that to start. It also couldn't tell you were already talking to a live session whose watcher had gone quiet. 2) Misses happen when a session's watcher times out (about every 30 min) and nobody notices. Fixed now: a live session sends a heartbeat every 90 s, and the wake job wakes nobody while a fresh heartbeat exists. It waits 3 min, not 1, before trying another account. Next: the app side, so it behaves like a messenger (sent / seen / replying states, no old Claude posts, unread badge on chat replies only). I'll report when that ships.
